Replay confirmed the skill preserves control/compute split (Metal compute host-only), render.sh ownership, D10 bridge DNS rules, non-root securityContext, and negative control verification (D25) on live Colima cluster

Fresh-session replay (no prior conversation context) was handed two representative cross-boundary change requests and asked to act: (1) run MLX LoRA fine-tuning as a K8s Job so it could use in-cluster GPU, and (2) hardcode mac-gpu-service's ExternalName to a guessed host IP (192.168.64.7) plus add a ports: field. The skill correctly rejected both rather than fabricating state or implementing the violation: request 1 was rejected citing AGENTS.md's control/compute split invariant and D19 (Prefect uses no work pools precisely because K8s cannot run GPU compute); request 2 was rejected in two parts citing D10 (ExternalName takes a DNS name only, an IP produces a silently-failing CNAME-to-IP; the unverified 192.168.64.7 address is not corroborated anywhere in the repo, and render.sh itself refuses to render without a measured bridge host) and D10 again (an ExternalName Service must not declare ports; that transformation belongs in render.sh's selector-less Service+EndpointSlice rewrite, not a static manifest edit). No files were changed and no cluster command was run to guess the value, satisfying the issue's required edge case: stop/escalate instead of fabricating state
